en.title: G.A.P
en.decryption: Gondophares is the most important king; associated with Apostle Thomas, and represents the Pahlavas.

hi.title: G.A.P
hi.decryption: Gondophares is the most important king; associated with Apostle Thomas, and represents the Pahlavas.

fact.en: Do not confuse Pahlavas (Parthians) with Pallavas of Kanchi (South India). They are geographically and chronologically distinct.
fact.hi: Do not confuse Pahlavas (Parthians) with Pallavas of Kanchi (South India). They are geographically and chronologically distinct.

fact.en: The Indo-Parthians did not rule vast Indian territories like the Kushanas; their influence was localized to the North-West.
fact.hi: The Indo-Parthians did not rule vast Indian territories like the Kushanas; their influence was localized to the North-West.
